# Falcon Roofing LLC

> Owner-led roofing contractor in Powell, serving Delaware County and Central Ohio. Residential shingle, commercial TPO/EPDM, gutters, siding and trim — installed clean, on schedule, with a single point of contact from quote to walk-through.

Falcon Roofing LLC is a small, owner-operated roofing company. The owner is on every job site. Quotes are offered Monday through Saturday. Direct line: (614) 715-0496.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Falcon Roofing — services, service area, and how to request a quote.
- [Roof Replacement](/roof-replacement): Full residential roof replacement — shingle systems, decking, underlayment, ventilation, flashing.
- [Roof Repair](/roof-repair): Targeted roof repairs — leaks, storm damage, flashing, missing shingles, pipe boots.
- [Commercial Roofing](/commercial-roofing): Commercial flat-roof systems — TPO, EPDM, repairs and replacement for low-slope buildings.
- [Gutters, Siding & Trim](/gutters-siding-trim): Gutter, siding and exterior trim work paired with roofing scope.
- [Service Area](/service-area): Powell, Delaware County and surrounding Central Ohio communities served by Falcon Roofing.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact form, phone, email and map for requesting a quote or scheduling a site visit.
